blocks.text: Update operation database ke maujooda data ko badalta hai. Yeh tab istemal hota hai jab rakhi hui maloomat durust karni ho. SQL UPDATE commands chune hue records badalti hain; Python yeh commands shart (condition, jaise WHERE ID = 1) ke mutabiq chalata hai. Is mein sirf bataya gaya data badalta hai.

blocks.title: Class Activity
blocks.text: Kisi student ke marks update karein aur naya (updated) data dikhayein.
UPDATE students SET Age = 21 WHERE ID = 1;
blocks.caption: Table 4.1 ki misal: sirf ID 1 ki umar 21

blocks.prompt: students table mein Sara ka grade '10th' karne ka SQL likhein, aur batayein ke baad mein Python ko kya call karna hoga.
blocks.explanation: UPDATE students SET grade = '10th' WHERE name = 'Sara'; phir connection.commit() taake tabdeeli mehfooz ho.

items: Update = UPDATE ... SET ... WHERE: sirf chune hue records badalte hain.
